note: Item codes are the .sav column names, unchanged by data/ecuador_2011_safety.do (Table 1 safety, local survey_cols I51 I52). The .sav variable labels tie both codes to the form by number and content, 2/2: I51 = "I51  Como calificaria Ud. la seguridad en este barrio" (q.5.1) and I52 = "I52. Como calificaria Ud. la seguridad en esta Ciudad" (q.5.2). Words are the official Spanish questionnaire p.5 (section V. PERCEPCION DE LA INSEGURIDAD PUBLICA), checked against the rendered page image, not the terse .sav labels: each question is its own complete item_text with the form spacing after the opening and before the closing question mark and accents as printed; the two are separate questions, so instructions is blank and there is one section; interviewer line MARQUE UN SOLO CODIGO not shipped. The scale line En una escala de 1 a 5 ... printed below these boxes belongs to q.5.3 (sibling ecuador_2011_safety_places), not to 5.1/5.2, and is not shipped here. Options: the form labels every point for both questions, in masculine for 5.1 (Muy Inseguro / Inseguro / Ni Inseguro ni Seguro / Seguro / Muy Seguro) and feminine for 5.2 (Muy Insegura / Insegura / Ni Insegura ni Segura / Segura / Muy Segura, agreeing with la seguridad en esta ciudad), with the form capitalisation; shipped per item as printed. The .sav value labels are the masculine set for BOTH items (1 Muy inseguro, 2 Inseguro, 3 Ni seguro  ni  inseguro [double spaces, and seguro/inseguro in the opposite order to the form], 4 Seguro, 5 Muy seguro, 8 No sabe, 9 no responde); the do-file maps those strings to 1-5 and drops 8/9, so form codes 1-5 = .sav codes 1-5 = IRW resp 1-5, no direction recode. Route 9 by server-side GROUP BY (no export): live item x resp counts equal .sav counts in 10/10 cells (I51 1..5 = 7707/42578/34824/31412/894; I52 = 25278/62592/18431/10415/340); dropped No sabe/No responde I51 286/36, I52 638/43.
